records.text: Charlie Kirk and Ben Shapiro differed about the conservative movement: Shapiro backed Ron DeSantis in the 2024 primary, Kirk backed Donald Trump, and Kirk saw Shapiro as a rival.
records.speaker: Blake Neff

appearances.snippet: Here's what he has to say. Blake (Blake Neff) writes, since some silly claims are being made right now, no, Charlie Kirk did not, okay, hate, operative word being hate Ben Shapiro. ... Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and Ben (Ben Shapiro) deferred about the best direction for the conservative movement. Ben (Ben Shapiro) supported Ron DeSantis in the 2024 primary while Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was all in for Trump (Donald J. Trump) from the start. ... J.D. Vance was one of Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s favorite politicians while Ben (Ben Shapiro) had been critical of him. Charlie (Charlie Kirk) saw Ben (Ben Shapiro) as a rival.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 14:02 presents this as Blake Neff's quoted post, and a current transcript archive reproduces the same post. Independent reporting also confirms that Shapiro initially backed DeSantis in the 2024 Republican primary before supporting Trump. Verification confirms Neff's post and the endorsement contrast; 'rival' remains Neff's characterization of Kirk's view.
